scope: T10 development binding (stage 2): the time chain, event times, TOF and beta, TOF species hypotheses, dE/dx retention and counter counts; synthetic data only; no calibration, alignment or PID quality claim (plan R31, R37)
sources: skills/hep-detector/references/calibration-and-alignment.md (alignment and weak modes; calibration standards; outer loops)
rule: an item that constrains a mode is never one of its independent observables (section 9.6): the constraint.* and observable.* identifiers of a mode are disjoint, and constraints_used names constraint identifiers of that mode only

unconstrained_modes.description: the gain x energy gauge of section 9.6: amplitudes A = g E are unchanged under g -> a g, E -> E / a; the walk coefficient a_c / sqrt(A) is defined against the amplitude scale in use (A -> lambda A with a_c -> a_c sqrt(lambda) leaves every corrected time unchanged)
unconstrained_modes.witness: t10_a37.py gxe_check: exact rank C + E - 1, two gauges with identical amplitudes, convergence and a same-type holdout equal in both; test_timing_a37 ChainGauge

constraining_information.text: a reference event or source of known energy (an external energy scale)
a test pulse of known charge on a channel

independent_observables.text: the most probable deposit of minimum-ionizing tracks at a known path length, not used in the derivation

unconstrained_modes.description: a common offset of every channel with an internal (common or leave-one-out) event time leaves every TOF unchanged, because the event time moves with it
unconstrained_modes.witness: t10_stage2.py pid, item shared-clock: external-time TOF moves by -delta, internal-time TOF by 0

constraining_information.text: an external start time (a start counter or the bunch clock)

independent_observables.text: the TOF of a species of known mass at a momentum where its beta is known

unconstrained_modes.description: the momentum source's weak mode (a sagitta-like curvature offset): q/p biased while the track chi2/ndf is essentially unchanged; it moves every t_pred and mass hypothesis of the TOF PID
unconstrained_modes.witness: CAI-T07-4, fixture 7004 against 7003, job 7546791 (cai-refit.log, SHA-256 pinned in t10_a37.py): in all 8 cells the q/p change is at least 4.5 per-track sigma while the mean chi2/ndf change is within 4.5 se

constraining_information.text: vertex or beam constraint (R37 names it as constraining the T07 mode)
cosmic-ray or halo tracks fitted as two independent halves

independent_observables.text: a resonance mass versus charge, direction and momentum
comparison of independent subdetectors measuring the same track

identifiable_combinations: charge-symmetric quantities insensitive to a curvature offset (at first order)

not_satisfying_a37: the placeholder convergence and unconstrained-mode checks of the T12 loop fixture
